REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: The receipt validator permits known token totals to be replaced by an unavailable effective-token value, bypassing the mandatory 500k reflection checkpoint.
FINDING: high|scripts/factory-ng-receipt-validate.py|When aggregate input/output are numeric, effective_tokens may still be an unavailable object|This permits known usage above 500k to evade the required warning/reflection control.
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Require numeric effective_tokens equal to input_tokens + output_tokens whenever both aggregates are numeric; add a failing fixture for numeric aggregates with unavailable effective_tokens.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: An accepted receipt with input_tokens=510000, output_tokens=1, effective_tokens={"availability":"unavailable","reason":"unknown"}, and status="telemetry_unavailable" passes the current schema and relationship validator without opening a reflection ticket.
